The content of this notebook will remain the same each time the file is rendered. This is because the `freeze` option is set to `true`.


```yaml
title: "Demo of a Julia Notebook With Freeze"

    freeze: false 
```
The results are saved in the `_freeze` folder, and we should not ignore this folder.

```{julia}
using Random, CairoMakie

rng = 1:5
nSim = 10

sim = rand(rng, nSim)

fig, ax, plt = barplot(
    1:nSim, sim
)
ax.title = "Picking $nSim Number With Replacement From 1 to 5"

fig
```
